meta.notes: Weights in Stein (1 Stein = 1 kg = 40 weight ounces, ~25 g each per CC conventions). Prices in silver thalers (CC-01). Weapons from Wege des Schwertes (WdS 2011) pp.124–133. secondary_talents lists every alternative combat talent; combat_talent drives UI grouping. Weapon focus bias at creation: use the highest talent among combat_talent + secondary_talents for AT/PA. New fields vs schema 1.x: break_factor (WdS BF column, break threshold); length_cm; tp_kk encodes TP/ST damage-scaling thresholds (e.g. '12/4'); distance_class (WdS DK — H grapple, N melee, S pole-arm, P pike; array when several apply); is_improvised ('i'); is_two_handed ('z'); is_ritual ('p'); reload_actions (WdS reloading steps, ranged); wounds_at_kko2minus2 (* in WdS table: shot may wound at CN/2 - 2 damage).

ranged_and_throwing.range_bands_schritt_upper_note: range_bands_schritt_upper: five upper inclusive limits in paces; order matches Reichweitenklassen (reichweiteklassen_order).
ranged_and_throwing.tp_plus_by_range_band_note: tp_plus_by_range_band: optional TP shifts per band. null = not applicable (dash in table).

weapons.name: Bastard Sword (Anderthalbhänder)
weapons.special: Can be wielded one- or two-handed. When two-handed: +1 DP. Quick grip switch (free action). No shield. Chain weapon blows cannot be parried.

weapons.name: Bastard Sword
weapons.special: One-handed (Swords) or two-handed (Bastard Sword talent). At ST 15+ one-handed: TP/ST 12/4, INI -1. No shield when two-handed.
weapons.notes: Five to six spans blade, long grip.

weapons.name: Nachtwind
weapons.special: Single-edged Maraskan blade; reinforced scabbard can parry. Multiple blades linkable. At AG 16+: one-handed with Swords (TP/ST unchanged).

weapons.name: Rondra's Comb
weapons.special: Long well-balanced bastard sword with flame-shaped (wavy) blade. Insignia of Rondra clergy. Privileged weapon.

weapons.name: Tuzak Knife
weapons.special: Maraskan sword; slightly curved 1.5-edged blade. Minimum AG 15; each point below reduces TP by 1, INI by 1, PA by 1.
weapons.notes: Wielded very fast; requires exceptional agility.

weapons.name: Basilisk Tongue
weapons.special: Flame-shaped blade, usually without parrying guards. Considered an assassin's weapon.
weapons.notes: Popular in Tulamide regions and Horasian Empire.

weapons.name: Borndorn
weapons.special: Triangular-bladed throwing dagger from the Bornland. Melee capable. Can be thrown (Throwing Knives talent).
weapons.notes: Stable enough for melee, balanced for throwing.

weapons.name: Dagger
weapons.special: Universal sidearm. Cannot parry chain, two-handed flail, two-handed blunt, or two-handed swords. Can be thrown (improvised).

weapons.name: Dragon Tooth
weapons.special: Broad sturdy dwarven dagger. Non-dwarves: -1 AT, PA, TP. Cannot parry chain, two-handed blunt, or two-handed swords.

weapons.name: Boar Catcher
weapons.special: Massive dagger approaching short sword in size; without parrying guards.

weapons.name: Hook Dagger
weapons.special: Rod-steel blade sharpened only at tip, with long upward-curved parrying prongs. Disarm from parade 2 pts easier. Can break opponent blade (PA+2 easier, ST check +4 easier). Cannot parry chain, two-handed flail, or two-handed blunt.

weapons.name: Hunting Knife
weapons.special: Slightly curved sharp knife for skinning. Poor parrying. Can be thrown (improvised).
weapons.notes: Standard tool knife. Elven versions finer (BF 1).

weapons.name: Short Sword
weapons.special: Straight blade, short parrying guards. Can be used with Swords, Sabers, or Daggers talent — use highest.
weapons.notes: Effective for over 2000 years in Aventuria.

weapons.name: Long Dagger
weapons.special: Narrow very long dagger, sometimes used off-hand. Can also be used as fencing weapon (use highest).

weapons.name: Main Gauche
weapons.special: Left-hand parrying dagger with long guards and broad guard. Cannot parry chain, two-handed flail, two-handed blunt, or two-handed swords. Optional blade-catcher (+5 weight oz.; +15 silver thalers) enables disarm. As off-hand parrying weapon (with Parrying Weapons I/II SA): primary weapon PA modified by −1 + PV (I) or +2 + PV (II).
weapons.notes: Off-hand companion to fencing/light swords in the Horasian Empire.

weapons.name: Mengbilar
weapons.special: Fragile dagger with poison channel. Poison damage adds to blade damage. Not suitable for melee (improvised weapon).

weapons.name: Knife
weapons.special: All unbalanced eating/work/utility knives of half to one span blade. Improvised weapon.

weapons.name: Ogre Catcher
weapons.special: Wide-bladed dagger with barbs that deploy on wounding hit — prevents removal. Lodged: 1d6 EP damage +1 Exhaustion each round moved. Forced removal: ST check; 1d6+3 VP. Careful removal: 1 GT, Heal Wounds check.

weapons.name: Disc Dagger
weapons.special: Long triangular/square steel spike with small parrying disc and disc pommel. Can deliver killing stroke (coup de grâce (Mercy Stroke)) to heavily armored opponents.

weapons.name: Heavy Dagger
weapons.special: Dagger with longer and wider blade than the ordinary dagger.

weapons.name: Obsidian Dagger
weapons.special: Ritual instrument of druids made from obsidian. Improvised weapon; extremely fragile. Not commercially available.

weapons.name: Waqqif
weapons.special: Broad curved dagger, both weapon and jewelry among Novadis. Counts as dagger for parrying restrictions. Can be used with Sabers or Daggers (use highest).

weapons.name: Throwing Dagger
weapons.special: Balanced for throwing (Throwing Knives talent). Melee: improvised. Cannot parry chain, two-handed blunt, two-handed swords, or halberds.

weapons.name: Throwing Knife (Melee)
weapons.special: Balanced for throwing (Throwing Knives talent). Melee: improvised. Cannot parry chain, two-handed blunt, or two-handed swords.

weapons.name: Épée
weapons.special: Narrow sword with elaborate guard. Cannot parry chain, two-handed flail, or two-handed blunt. Foil/Magierdegen also cannot parry two-handed swords.
weapons.notes: The essence of fencing weapons. Almada and Horasian Empire.

weapons.name: Foil
weapons.special: Thrusting weapon with no edge, only a point. Bell-shaped guard. Very flexible. Cannot parry chain, two-handed flail, two-handed blunt, or two-handed swords.

weapons.name: Mage Rapier
weapons.special: Representation weapon of some guild mages. Very light and delicate. Cannot parry chain, two-handed flail, two-handed blunt, or two-handed swords.

weapons.name: Armor Piercer
weapons.special: Hybrid disc-dagger/rapier. Designed to pierce heavy armor. No AR penalty for targeted thrust vs. armored opponents.

weapons.name: Rapier
weapons.special: Narrow sword with decorated guard. Cannot parry chain or two-handed blunt. Counts as sword for parrying restrictions. Can also be used with Swords (use highest).
weapons.notes: Transitions between épée, rapier, and sword are fluid.

weapons.name: Seal Killer
weapons.special: Sturdy saber with straight blade; single-edged with both tip and broad back. Can use Sabers, Swords, or Fencing Weapons talent — use highest.

weapons.name: Sword Cane
weapons.special: Trick weapon: concealed blade inside a walking stick, without parrying guards. Often decorated and very expensive.

weapons.name: Wolf Knife
weapons.special: Wood Elven hunting rapier with robust triangular blade. Can use Fencing, Swords, or Sabers — use highest. Counts as sword for parrying restrictions.

weapons.name: Baccanaq / Bakka
weapons.special: Multiple curved claws on wooden shaft from southern Aventurian jungles. Uses stone weapon breakage rules (BF 5). Bakka variant (Gjalskerland): BF 4, normal rules.

weapons.name: Hatchet
weapons.special: Short hand axe; improvised weapon against mobile targets. Can be thrown (improvised).

weapons.name: Brabak Flail
weapons.special: Mace with spines on heavy ball. Central spine: Daggers AT+3, own PA after+3, deals 1d6+6 TP; Knockdown rule does not apply to spike thrust.

weapons.name: Byakka
weapons.special: Orkish axe like enlarged Thorwaler Skraja. Spike thrust: Daggers AT+3, own PA after+3, deals 1d6+6 TP; Knockdown rule does not apply.

weapons.name: Torch
weapons.special: Each time torch deals SP, adds 1d6-1 fire damage. If fire roll = 6, torch goes out. Improvised weapon.

weapons.name: Cleaver
weapons.special: Butcher's meat and bone cleaver. Improvised weapon.

weapons.name: Haumesser
weapons.special: Top-heavy work knife for clearing paths. Improvised in combat. Can also be used with Sabers talent (use highest).

weapons.name: Spiked Club
weapons.special: Club reinforced with iron bands and long nails. Blunt weapon — can stun.

weapons.name: Bone Club
weapons.special: Shaman ritual instrument in various sizes. Can be modified by astral energy. Values for unenchanted medium version. Not commercially available.

weapons.name: Club
weapons.special: Blunt Blow at only -2 AT penalty (not -4). Can be used to knock unconscious.

weapons.name: War Fan
weapons.special: Aranean decorative fan as weapon. Opening/closing: 1 action each. Closed: dagger-like parrying restrictions. Open: only vs. daggers and fencing weapons. Full-metal variant usable as small shield vs. ranged ≤1d6+4 TP.

weapons.name: Lindworm Beater
weapons.special: Dwarven hand axe with extremely long-bearded blade; very heavy for its size.

weapons.name: Molokdeschnaja
weapons.special: Weapon traded by the Norbards; popular among Fjarnings; also useful as wood-working tool.

weapons.name: Orknase (Axes/Maces)
weapons.special: Thorwaler bearded axe. Can be used one-handed with Axes/Maces at ST 14+ (TP/ST 13/3). Primary entry; see Two-Handed Blunt for two-handed use.

weapons.name: Raven's Beak
weapons.special: Light cavalry reiterhammer with blunt face and pointed beak.

weapons.name: Forge Hammer
weapons.special: Ritual instrument of Ingerimm clergy. Forceful blow has Knockdown effect. Not commercially available.

weapons.name: Sickle
weapons.special: Curved harvesting blade. Improvised weapon. Counts as dagger for parrying restrictions.

weapons.name: Skraja
weapons.special: Thorwaler double-bladed hand axe, often with additional long spike at tip. Spike thrust (Daggers AT+3): 1d6+3 TP.

weapons.name: Sun Scepter
weapons.special: Twelve-flamed dignity symbol of Praios clergy, combat-ready. Not commercially available.

weapons.name: Battle Axe
weapons.special: Generic war axe; known in some form in all Aventurian cultures.

weapons.name: Mace
weapons.special: Classic blunt weapon with up to eight iron striking fins. Can break bones and armor.
weapons.notes: Popular with clergy who shun edged weapons.

weapons.name: Chair Leg
weapons.special: Last resort improvised weapon.

weapons.name: Throwing Hatchet (Melee)
weapons.special: Can be thrown (Throwing Axes talent). Melee: improvised. Cannot parry chain or two-handed blunt attacks.
weapons.notes: Balanced throwing axe with wooden handle.

weapons.name: Throwing Club (Melee)
weapons.special: Head-heavy throwing stick. Not designed for melee; improvised in close combat.

weapons.name: Dwarf Skraja
weapons.special: Dwarven-sized version of the Thorwaler Skraja adapted for Angroschim proportions.

weapons.name: Glaive
weapons.special: Broad single-edged blade on long haft, usually without tip. +2 AT vs. mounted. Two-handed; no shield.

weapons.name: Hook Spear
weapons.special: Affordable militia weapon; can unhorse mounted opponents. Two-handed.

weapons.name: Halberd
weapons.special: Axe blade + spear tip + hook. Cannot be parried by daggers or fencing weapons. +3 AT vs. mounted. Hook can pull riders from mounts. Two-handed.

weapons.name: Kor Spear
weapons.special: Spear with extremely broad nine-tined blade. Ritual weapon of Kor clergy. Two-handed.

weapons.name: Neethaner Long Axe
weapons.special: Long axe blade (sometimes tapering to a point) on even longer haft. Two-handed.

weapons.name: Pailos
weapons.special: Heavy axe blade and thrust tip on massive shaft with hand guard. Only two-handed blunt maneuvers allowed. Thrust (Spears AT+5, PA+5): 1d6+7 TP; can Knockdown. Two-handed.

weapons.name: Partisan
weapons.special: Broad thrust blade with symmetric side blades. Counts as pole weapon. Two-handed.

weapons.name: Schnitter
weapons.special: Blade-staff developed from war scythe. At AG 16+: one-handed with Spears or Axes/Maces (TP 1d6+3, TP/ST 15/5; AT/PA weapon mod. 0/-1). Two-handed.

weapons.name: Scythe
weapons.special: Agricultural harvesting tool; improvised weapon for rebellious peasants. Two-handed.

weapons.name: War Scythe
weapons.special: Scythe blade mounted lengthwise on haft, creating effective polearm. Two-handed.

weapons.name: Warunker Hammer
weapons.special: Multi-purpose weapon: thrust tip, flat hammer head, and axe blade on long haft with hand guard. Thrust (Spears AT+3): 1d6+5 TP, cannot Knockdown. Two-handed.

weapons.name: Wurm Spear
weapons.special: Dwarven variant of the partisan, sized for Angroschim. Two-handed.

weapons.name: Chain Staff
weapons.special: Minimum AG 15. Ignores shield PA bonus. Disarm from attack 4 pts easier. Convert AT to PA action without penalty from TP 10. Two-handed.
weapons.notes: Two hardwood staves connected by chain.

weapons.name: Three-Section Staff
weapons.special: Three shorter sections connected by chains. Same special rules as chain staff. Two-handed.
weapons.notes: Variant chain staff with three sections.

weapons.name: Scourge
weapons.special: Whip with ~2-span grip and ~3-span lash. Ignores shield PA bonus. Attack only — cannot parry.

weapons.name: Chain Ball
weapons.special: Crude iron ball with welded chain; no handle (sometimes with ring for throwing). Can be thrown (Sling talent) but flies poorly.

weapons.name: Morning Star
weapons.special: Spiked ball on chain. Can strike around shield edge — shield PA bonus not applied. All parries +2 difficulty. Fumble at 19-20; control check +2 difficulty.

weapons.name: Nine-Tails
weapons.special: Nine lash cords weighted at ends. Ignores shield PA bonus. Vs. swarms: AT/2 hits 2 targets, critical hits 3 (equal TP roll). Vs. human: AT/2 +1 TP.

weapons.name: Ox Herd
weapons.special: Three-ball morning star. Minimum ST 16. Ignores shield PA. All parries +2 difficulty. Fumble at 19-20; control check +4 difficulty.

weapons.name: Ogre Bell
weapons.special: Two-ball morning star. Minimum ST 15. Ignores shield PA. All parries +2 difficulty. Fumble at 19-20; control check +3 difficulty.

weapons.name: Whip
weapons.special: Pure attack talent — no PA. Ignores shield PA bonus. Can disarm or knock opponent off feet. AT-8 at close quarters; cannot be used in grapple range.
weapons.notes: Long coachman's whip; used only by true specialists.

weapons.name: Amazon Saber
weapons.special: Narrow sword with single-edged curved blade; also called cavalry saber. Can use Sabers or Swords (use highest).

weapons.name: Arbach
weapons.special: Orkish saber with slightly curved flame-shaped blade and simple hand guard. Can use Sabers or Swords (use highest).

weapons.name: Cutlass
weapons.special: Broad single-edged straight blade with basket guard. Short heavy blade for close quarters.

weapons.name: Khunchomer
weapons.special: Typical Tulamide saber; widens from grip (top-heavy); no tip.

weapons.name: Kusliker Saber
weapons.special: Straight mostly-double-edged sword with decorated narrow guard; also called basket-sword. Can use Sabers or Swords (use highest).

weapons.name: Saber
weapons.special: Single-edged slightly curved blade with worked tip; basket or guard hilt; no parrying guards. Can use Sabers or Swords (use highest).

weapons.name: Slavedeath
weapons.special: Broad southern Aventurian saber related to Khunchomer; sometimes with barbs.

weapons.name: Barbarian Sword
weapons.special: Archaic transition form between sword and axe. Blade/decorations often bronze. Can use Swords or Axes/Maces (use highest).

weapons.name: Broad Sword
weapons.special: Slightly archaic sword form with broad blade; usually without parrying guard.

weapons.name: Sword
weapons.special: The Aventurian long sword with straight or slightly downward-curved parrying guard. Status symbol of all fighting professions.

weapons.name: Tournament Sword
weapons.special: Tournament-balanced sword with blunt soft edges; deals TP(A). Wooden version: TP 1d6+1(A), BF 5.

weapons.name: Dragon Slayer
weapons.special: Overlong dwarven spear with serrated blade from secret alloy. Requires Spear Team ability. Not commercially available. Two-handed.

weapons.name: Trident
weapons.special: Three-pronged spear. On successful AT: opponent rolls to avoid disarm (ST vs. AT). Can catch weapon on critical PA.

weapons.name: Dschadra
weapons.special: Tulamide short cavalry lance. Usable on horseback, in melee, or thrown (Throwing Spears). Thrown from horseback: +2 TP.

weapons.name: Efferd's Trident
weapons.special: Efferd clergy trident with three points arranged for superior parrying and disarming. Can be thrown. Hit causes Knockdown.

weapons.name: Wooden Spear
weapons.special: -2 TP vs. plate armor. Stone/horn tip variants +1 TP vs. cloth/thin leather (BF check vs. plate). One-handed (TP 1d6+2, TP/ST 13/5; AT/PA weapon mod. -1/-6). Can be thrown.

weapons.name: Hunting Spear
weapons.special: Spear with crossbar behind blade to prevent over-penetration. One-handed at ST 15+ (TP 1d6+5, TP/ST 13/5; AT/PA weapon mod. 0/-4). Elven variants: lighter (75 wt. oz.), sturdier (BF 2).

weapons.name: War Lance (On Foot)
weapons.special: Values for improvised use on foot as spear. For mounted jousting use Jousting talent (see WdS p. 106). Two-handed.

weapons.name: Pike
weapons.special: Overlong sturdy spear; only truly effective in formation (Formation and Spear Team abilities). Two-handed; no shield.

weapons.name: Spear
weapons.special: ~1.5-pace shaft with lance-shaped thrust blade. One-handed at ST 16+ (TP 1d6+4, TP/ST 13/5; AT/PA weapon mod. 0/-5). Can be thrown (improvised).
weapons.notes: Standard spear; mainly for hunters now.

weapons.name: Boar Spear
weapons.special: Long spear with broad blade, crossbar and hand guard for hunting heavy game. Two-handed.

weapons.name: Tournament Lance
weapons.special: Values for improvised use on foot (deals TP(A)). For jousting use see WdS p. 106. Very fragile. Two-handed.

weapons.name: Javelin (Melee)
weapons.special: ~4-span balanced throwing spear with iron tip on heavy wooden shaft. Melee use improvised. Can be thrown as primary use (see ranged entry).

weapons.name: Quarterstaff
weapons.special: Two-handed. Disarm from attack 2 pts easier. Blunt weapon — can stun.

weapons.name: Wizard Staff
weapons.special: Ritual instrument and status symbol of mages. Indestructible (BF: N/A). Crystal-ball variant: two-handed blunt weapon. Short variants: axes/maces. Not commercially available.

weapons.name: Two-Lily Staff
weapons.special: Staff with broad dagger blades and small hooks at both ends. Disarm from attack 4 pts easier. Two-handed.

weapons.name: Threshing Flail
weapons.special: Agricultural tool; improvised weapon. Ignores shield PA bonus. Two-handed.

weapons.name: War Flail
weapons.special: Iron-banded well-balanced war version. Ignores shield PA bonus. Two-handed.

weapons.name: Barbarian Battle Axe
weapons.special: Massive double-bladed axe. Used primarily in northern Aventuria. Two-handed.

weapons.name: Achaz Axe
weapons.special: Rare long-hafted double-bladed axe of the Achaz. Thrust tip (Spears AT+3): 1d6+4 TP; Knockdown rule does not apply. All Staves maneuvers and Pinning usable. Two-handed. Not commercially available.

weapons.name: Rock Splitter
weapons.special: Dwarven double-bladed axe sized for Angroschim. Two-handed.

weapons.name: Gruufhai
weapons.special: Orkish war hammer with spines on large striking face. One-handed with Axes/Maces at ST 18+ (TP/ST 15/3). Two-handed.

weapons.name: Woodcutter Axe
weapons.special: Work tool; improvised weapon. Two-handed.

weapons.name: War Hammer
weapons.special: Heavy war hammer. One-handed with Axes/Maces at ST 18+ (TP/ST 15/3). Striking face sometimes spiked. Two-handed.

weapons.name: Neethaner Long Axe (2H)
weapons.special: Long axe blade on even longer haft. Two-handed. See Infantry Weapons entry for Infantry talent use.

weapons.name: Orknase (2H)
weapons.special: Thorwaler bearded axe. One-handed with Axes/Maces at ST 14+ (TP/ST 13/3). Two-handed.

weapons.name: Pailos (2H)
weapons.special: Only two-handed blunt maneuvers. Thrust (Spears AT+5, PA+5): 1d6+7 TP; can Knockdown. Two-handed.

weapons.name: Executioner Sword
weapons.special: Very broad top-heavy blade. Not intended for combat — improvised weapon. Kept in city arsenals for executioners. Not commercially available.

weapons.name: Pickaxe
weapons.special: Work tool; improvised weapon. One-handed with Axes/Maces at ST 18+ (TP/ST 14/3). Two-handed.

weapons.name: Sledgehammer
weapons.special: Construction work tool; improvised weapon. Two-handed.

weapons.name: Warunker Hammer (2H)
weapons.special: Multi-purpose: thrust tip, hammer head, axe blade. Thrust (Spears AT+3): 1d6+5 TP, cannot Knockdown. Two-handed.

weapons.name: Dwarf Maul
weapons.special: Dwarven war hammer sized for Angroschim. Two-handed.

weapons.name: Andergaster
weapons.special: Overlong two-handed sword with long false edge. Despite the name, favored by Almadan and Horasian double mercenaries. Two-handed.

weapons.name: Bastard Sword (Two-Handed Swords)
weapons.special: See Bastard Sword entry (bastard_sword talent). Can also be used with Two-Handed Swords talent. Quick grip switch. Two-handed.

weapons.name: Boron's Sickle
weapons.special: Overlong curved sword with one-and-a-half-edged blade designed against cavalry; usually without parrying guards. Popular in Almada and Aranien. Two-handed.

weapons.name: Double Khunchomer
weapons.special: Impressive bladed weapon from Tulamide region; carried by bodyguards and harem guards for intimidation. Two-handed.

weapons.name: Great Slavedeath
weapons.special: Southern Aventurian variant of the double khunchomer; often decorated; sometimes with barbs. Two-handed.

weapons.name: Rondra's Comb (Two-Handed Swords)
weapons.special: See Bastard Sword entry. Can also be used with Two-Handed Swords. Ritual weapon. Two-handed.

weapons.name: Tuzak Knife (Two-Handed Swords)
weapons.special: See Bastard Sword entry. Can also be used with Two-Handed Swords. Minimum AG 15. Two-handed.

weapons.name: Two-Handed Sword
weapons.special: Broad-bladed double-edged sword with long grip. Rather front-heavy. Two-handed; no shield.

weapons.name: Punch
weapons.special: Endurance-only damage (EP, type A): apply half again to VP. Metal knuckles/gauntlets: +2 damage to that endurance roll when halving. Weapon AT/PA modifiers apply only when the opponent carries a weapon.

weapons.name: Kick / Head Butt
weapons.special: Same endurance-only rule (EP A). Boots/helmet: +2 damage as above. Weapon AT/PA modifiers apply only when the opponent carries a weapon.

weapons.name: Wrestling Hold
weapons.special: On hit begins grapple; opposed rolls each round. Grappled character cannot Attack. May escalate to choke (+1d6 VP/round) or throw (fall damage). AT/PA weapon mod. -1/-2 when opponent has a weapon.

weapons.name: Dragon Claw
weapons.special: Deals real TP (not TP(A)). No other weapon or shield in that hand. Interchangeable attachments. Not commercially available at base price.

weapons.name: Veteran Hand
weapons.special: Four short blades spring from back of hand when fist is clenched. Deals real TP. No other weapon or shield in that hand.

weapons.name: Knuckle Duster
weapons.special: Bronze/iron rings. Deals TP(A) but +2 more than bare fist. No other weapon or shield in that hand.

weapons.name: Orchid
weapons.special: Curved blades smithed onto knuckle duster; hand resembles claw. Deals real TP. No other weapon or shield in that hand.

weapons.name: Gauntlet
weapons.special: Stiff armored gauntlet extending past elbow with spike at clenched fist. Used primarily as shield/parry. Deals real TP.

weapons.name: Bock
weapons.special: Heavy fist shield with 1-3 long spines. Used as shield/parry. Disarm from parade 2 pts easier.

weapons.name: Shield Bash
weapons.special: Improvised attack using any shield; weight/cost depend on shield used.

weapons.name: War Lance (Mounted)
weapons.special: Mounted: jousting talent (AT only, cannot parry). Charge damage multiplied by mount speed factor. On foot as spear: Spears talent at AT-2.

weapons.name: Blowpipe
weapons.special: Darts usually poison-coated. Only from horseback on stationary mount.

weapons.name: Borndorn (Thrown)
weapons.special: Stable triangular blade; also usable in melee (Daggers talent).

weapons.name: Dagger (Improvised Throw)
weapons.special: Improvised throw only. Long dagger, dragon tooth, heavy dagger, hunting knife, knife not suitable for throwing at all.

weapons.name: Throwing Dagger
weapons.special: Balanced for throwing. Melee use improvised.

weapons.name: Throwing Knife
weapons.special: Balanced for throwing. Melee use improvised.

weapons.name: Throwing Disc / Ring / Star
weapons.special: Sharp-edged/notched metal discs. Can be thrown in volleys (Hagel rules WdS p.95). Some produce tones.

weapons.name: Dschadra (Thrown)
weapons.special: Tulamide cavalry javelin. +2 TP when thrown from horseback.

weapons.name: Efferd's Trident (Thrown)
weapons.special: A hit causes Knockdown effect.

weapons.name: Grenade Apple
weapons.special: Clay ball filled with Hylailan fire. Light fuse and throw/sling. On impact: spreads burning oil. Not freely available. Botch = thrower set on fire.

weapons.name: Wooden Spear (Thrown)
weapons.special: Primitive tribal throwing spear.

weapons.name: Spear (Thrown)
weapons.special: Ordinary spear can be thrown (improvised). Also melee weapon (Spears talent).

weapons.name: Spear Thrower
weapons.special: Guide stick with groove extending the thrower's arm by half a pace. Rare; used by some steppe peoples, Tocamuyac, and Firnelves.

weapons.name: Staff Sling
weapons.special: Sling mounted on straight rod (lever-sling). Cannot be used from horseback.

weapons.name: Javelin
weapons.special: Well-balanced throwing spear with iron tip on heavy wooden shaft. Hit can wound at CN/2 - 2 threshold. Melee: improvised.

weapons.name: Schneidzahn
weapons.special: Thorwaler ornamental throwing axe with complex flight path. RC check +1 difficulty. Target must be ≥5 paces.

weapons.name: Throwing Axe
weapons.special: Fully metal; sharpened on all sides. Target must be ≥5 paces. Melee use: improvised (Axes/Maces).

weapons.name: Throwing Club
weapons.special: Tumbling throwing stick. Deals 2d6+4 TP(A) + half rolled points as real damage.

weapons.name: Arbalest
weapons.special: Heavy torsion weapon firing lead balls; cranked. Hit can cause Knockdown. Usually fired resting on support stick. See Arbalette notes (WdS p.128).

weapons.name: Arbalone
weapons.special: Massive ball-firing torsion weapon on tripod from Horasian Empire. Hit causes Knockdown. Cannot be fired from horseback.

weapons.name: Balestra
weapons.special: Cavalry and hunting torsion crossbow from Horasian Empire; cocked with goat's-foot lever. Hit can cause Knockdown.

weapons.name: Balestrina
weapons.special: Fist-sized torsion crossbow cocked with underlever. Fires balls.

weapons.name: Balläster
weapons.special: Ball-firing crossbow popular with nobles for bird hunting. Often ornate.

weapons.name: Eisenwalder
weapons.special: Magazine crossbow; 10-bolt capacity. Cocking also loads next bolt. Refill: 2 actions/bolt. After march: fouling check (19-20 on 1d20 = needs 3 GT cleaning). Hit can wound at CN/2 - 2.

weapons.name: Light Crossbow
weapons.special: Cocked with goat's-foot. Popular hunting/militia weapon. Reload time doubles if ST < 12. Hit can wound at CN/2 - 2.

weapons.name: Windlass Crossbow
weapons.special: Heavy crossbow requiring winch to cock. Extremely long reload. High range and precision. After march: fouling check. Hit can wound at CN/2 - 2.

weapons.name: Elf Bow
weapons.special: Elven mastercraft bow; slightly shorter than long bow. Not commercially available; not usually in human hands. Hit can wound at CN/2 - 2.

weapons.name: Composite Bow
weapons.special: Layered horn/sinew/wood construction. Minimum ST 15; below that all targets one range class farther and -2 TP. Hit can wound at CN/2 - 2.

weapons.name: War Bow
weapons.special: Extremely stiff short bow. Minimum ST 16; below that all targets one class farther, -2 TP. Mounted use only for Cavalry Archers. Hit can wound at CN/2 - 2.

weapons.name: Short Bow
weapons.special: Typical Aventurian hunting bow (4-6 spans); widely used as cavalry weapon. Hit can wound at CN/2 - 2.

weapons.name: Long Bow
weapons.special: Body-length bow (8+ spans). Minimum ST 15; below that all targets one class farther, -2 TP. Cannot be used from horseback. Hit can wound at CN/2 - 2.

weapons.name: Ork Cavalry Bow
weapons.special: Crude-looking but effective composite short bow. Minimum ST 15; below that targets one class farther. Hit can wound at CN/2 - 2.

weapons.name: Fledermaus
weapons.special: Two metal weights on cord. Deals no real TP — value is escape check difficulty penalty (per round; fail = +1 difficulty).

weapons.name: Grenade Apple (Slung)
weapons.special: Slung version of the Hylailan fire grenade. Not freely available.

weapons.name: Chain Ball (Slung)
weapons.special: Can be thrown (slung) but flies poorly. Primarily a melee chain weapon (chain_weapons talent).

weapons.name: Lasso
weapons.special: Leather rope with weighted loop. Deals no real TP — value is escape check difficulty penalty.

weapons.name: Sling
weapons.special: Shepherd weapon. Special lead shot: +1 TP. Ordinary matching stones freely available.

weapons.name: Throwing Net
weapons.special: RC check +8 (modified by target size) at all ranges ≤5 paces. Hit: 1d6+2 + announce = escape difficulty. Fail = +1 difficulty per round.

weapons.name: Heavy Throwing Net
weapons.special: RC check +10. Hit: 1d6+6 + announce = escape difficulty. Fail = +1 difficulty per round.

weapons.name: Discus
weapons.special: Maraskan hardwood throwing disc, often decorated. Optional TP/ST 13/3.

weapons.name: Hunting Discus
weapons.special: Deals TP(A). Hunting variant. Optional TP/ST 13/3.

weapons.name: Combat Discus
weapons.special: Razor-sharp steel edge. Requires throwing glove (15 silver thalers) and minimum ST 14. Some produce howling sounds. Hit can wound at CN/2 - 2.

weapons.name: Stone / Bottle (Improvised)
weapons.special: Use best throwing talent -3 if no clear category fits.

weapons.name: Simple Wood Shield
weapons.special: Basic wappenform shield of cross-laminated wood boards, leather-edged and covered.

weapons.name: Reinforced Wood Shield
weapons.special: Round/octagonal/wappenform shield with iron reinforcements at edges and bands/rivets on face. Felt-lined back.

weapons.name: Leather Shield
weapons.special: Round wooden frame covered with multiple layers of tough leather. Common among riding peoples.

weapons.name: Mat Shield
weapons.special: Woven reed mat shield of the Achaz; surprisingly sturdy. Rectangular or oval on wooden frame.

weapons.name: Large Leather Shield
weapons.special: Larger oval or teardrop-shaped leather shield for cavalry use. Popular as infantry shield among some steppe peoples.

weapons.name: Thorwaler Shield
weapons.special: Large round wooden shield with iron edges and usually an iron boss in center. Often painted with Thorwaler ornaments.

weapons.name: Great Shield
weapons.special: Long teardrop-shaped cavalry shield of multi-layered glued wood and leather. Usually painted in heraldic colors. Counts as large cover for ranged attacks.

weapons.name: Tower Shield
weapons.special: ~Eight-span high rectangle of multiple wood/leather layers, usually with spike at bottom and struts to stand it up. Standard crossbowman shield.

weapons.name: Buckler
weapons.special: Small fist shield of wood and/or leather; half-sphere with narrow rim. Not suitable against two-handed blunt or two-handed swords.

weapons.name: Full-Metal Buckler
weapons.special: Steel fist shield; flat dome with ~hand-wide rim, leather/felt lined. Not suitable against two-handed blunt.

weapons.name: Gauntlet (Shield)
weapons.special: Armored gauntlet; spike at clenched fist. Used primarily as shield/parry.

weapons.name: Dragon Claw (Shield)
weapons.special: Robust versatile gauntlet variant. Can have blade-catcher or blade-breaker. Not commercially available at base price.

weapons.name: Bock (Shield)
weapons.special: Heavy fist shield with 1-3 long spines. Disarm from parade 2 pts easier.

weapons.name: Hook Dagger (Parrying)
weapons.special: Parrying weapon. Not suitable against chain, two-handed flail, or two-handed blunt. Disarm from parade +2. Can break opponent blade (PA+2, ST+4). With Parrying Weapons I/II SA: primary weapon PA modified by −1 + PV (I) or +2 + PV (II).

weapons.name: War Fan (Parrying)
weapons.special: Parrying weapon only usable with daggers, light swords, and sabers. Open/close: 1 action each. With Parrying Weapons I/II SA: primary weapon PA modified by −1 + PV (I) or +2 + PV (II).

weapons.name: Main Gauche (Parrying)
weapons.special: Parrying dagger. Blade-catcher option enables disarm; blade-breaker option can break blades. With Parrying Weapons I/II SA: primary weapon PA modified by −1 + PV (I) or +2 + PV (II).

weapons.name: Long Dagger (Parrying)
weapons.special: Can be used as parrying weapon. With Parrying Weapons I/II SA: primary weapon PA modified by −1 + PV (I) or +2 + PV (II).
